calls.title: GrowthBook AI
calls.summary: The discussion centered on evolving GrowthBook’s AI capabilities to automate and scale experimentation and feature flag management. Key highlights included the introduction of AI skills that streamline over 250 API endpoints, allowing users to run 100 to 200 experiments concurrently. The 'Experiment Brainstorm' skill utilizes historical data to suggest new experiments, supporting organizations with mature experimentation cultures. There was an emphasis on shared knowledge and collaboration across teams to enhance insights and decision-making. Additionally, concerns regarding pricing and token governance for customers like Change.org were addressed, along with the strategy to maintain a demo workspace that safely showcases these innovations while ensuring a seamless user experience.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook AI, feature flags, experiment brainstorming, API integration, token governance, demo workspace
